Package org.cyborgcats.field

Class FieldElement<T>

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.field.FieldElement<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the underlying value type, e.g. Translation2d, Pose2d, or Bounds
public class FieldElement<T> extends Object
A field constant defined once from the blue-alliance perspective that transparently mirrors itself to the red side via AllianceUtil on every read, and self-registers with FieldElementRegistry so it can be logged automatically each loop.

    • getBlueValue

      public T getBlueValue()
      Returns the original blue-alliance value, ignoring the current alliance.
      Returns:
      the un-flipped, blue-perspective value

    • get

      public T get()
      Returns the value as seen from the current alliance's perspective. Overridden by each ofX factory to apply the correct AllianceUtil flip for T; the base implementation just returns the un-flipped blue value.
      Returns:
      the alliance-corrected value

    • log

      public void log()
      Logs the current alliance-corrected value to AdvantageKit under key. Overridden by each ofX factory; called by FieldElementRegistry every loop, not normally invoked directly. No-op in the base implementation.

    • ofTranslation2d

      public static FieldElement<Translation2d> ofTranslation2d(String key, double x, double y)
      Creates a FieldElement<Translation2d> that mirrors about the field center for red alliance. Translations are logged as poses with a defualt rotation2d object to be easily viewed in advantage scope
      Parameters:
      key - the AdvantageKit logging key
      x - the blue-alliance X coordinate, in meters
      y - the blue-alliance Y coordinate, in meters
      Returns:
      the newly created field element
